get.description:
Base for client-realm CRUD.

The class-level `queryset` MUST be declared on the unscoped `all_objects`
manager (e.g. `Model.all_objects.all()`), because a class-body reference to
the scoped `objects` manager would evaluate the fail-closed guard at import
time (no request context yet) and raise. At request time `get_queryset`
returns the *scoped* `objects` queryset — so isolation is enforced by the
manager, while schema generation (no context) sees a safe empty queryset.

`account` is injected on create from context — never trusted from the body.
URLs and lookups use `public_id`.

Base for client-realm CRUD.

The class-level `queryset` MUST be declared on the unscoped `all_objects`
manager (e.g. `Model.all_objects.all()`), because a class-body reference to
the scoped `objects` manager would evaluate the fail-closed guard at import
time (no request context yet) and raise. At request time `get_queryset`
returns the *scoped* `objects` queryset — so isolation is enforced by the
manager, while schema generation (no context) sees a safe empty queryset.

`account` is injected on create from context — never trusted from the body.
URLs and lookups use `public_id`.
